job.name: Playwright Synthetic Monitor — Global
job.description: Runs all synthetic monitoring tests across all 80+ sites every 5 minutes

option.name: SITE_GROUP
option.label: Site Group Filter
option.description: Limit to a specific region/group. Leave blank for all.

option.name: SITE_CONCURRENCY
option.label: Parallel Site Runs
option.description: Number of sites to test simultaneously

option.name: RUN_TAGS
option.label: Tag Filter
option.description: Comma-separated tags (erp, ssrs). Leave blank for all.

command.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
export SITE_GROUP="@option.SITE_GROUP@" export SITE_CONCURRENCY="@option.SITE_CONCURRENCY@" export RUN_TAGS="@option.RUN_TAGS@"
# Ensure working directory cd /opt/playwright-monitor
# Load environment [[ -f .env ]] && source .env
echo "[RunDeck] Starting Playwright Synthetic Monitor" echo "[RunDeck] Group: ${SITE_GROUP:-all} | Concurrency: ${SITE_CONCURRENCY}" echo "[RunDeck] Time: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
bash scripts/run-monitoring.sh
EXIT_CODE=$? echo "[RunDeck] Completed with exit code: ${EXIT_CODE}" exit ${EXIT_CODE}

email.subject: [ALERT] Playwright Monitor FAILED — @option.SITE_GROUP@
email.message:
Playwright Synthetic Monitor job FAILED.
Job: @job.name@ Execution: @execution.id@ Start Time: @execution.dateStarted@ End Time: @execution.dateEnded@ Duration: @execution.elapsed@
View details: @execution.href@

webhook.message: {"text":"⚠️ Playwright Monitor FAILED for group: @option.SITE_GROUP@ — execution @execution.id@"}

job.name: Playwright Monitor — US East
job.description: Synthetic monitoring for US East region sites — every 5 minutes

command.script: #!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail cd /opt/playwright-monitor [[ -f .env ]] && source .env export SITE_GROUP="us-east" export SITE_CONCURRENCY="${SITE_CONCURRENCY:-5}" bash scripts/run-monitoring.sh

job.name: Playwright Monitor — Europe
job.description: Synthetic monitoring for Europe region sites — every 5 minutes

command.script: #!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail cd /opt/playwright-monitor [[ -f .env ]] && source .env export SITE_GROUP="eu-west eu-central eu-east eu-south eu-north" bash scripts/run-monitoring.sh

job.name: Playwright Monitor — API Quick Check
job.description: Lightweight middleware API health check — every 2 minutes

command.script: #!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail cd /opt/playwright-monitor [[ -f .env ]] && source .env export RUN_TAGS="api" npx playwright test tests/synthetic/middleware-api.spec.ts \ --reporter=list,json \ --output=reports/artifacts/api-quick

#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail RETAIN_DAYS="${REPORT_RETENTION_DAYS:-30}" REPORT_DIR="/opt/playwright-monitor/reports" echo "Removing reports older than ${RETAIN_DAYS} days from ${REPORT_DIR}" find "${REPORT_DIR}" -type f -mtime "+${RETAIN_DAYS}" -name "*.json" -delete find "${REPORT_DIR}/logs" -type f -mtime "+${RETAIN_DAYS}" -name "*.log" -delete find "${REPORT_DIR}/artifacts" -type d -empty -delete echo "Cleanup complete"
